chapters.title: Storm clouds over the coast
paragraphs: Low dark clouds gather over small boats, cranes and the working waterfront.

photos.alt: A broad bank of dark storm clouds above small boats and the working waterfront.
photos.caption: A broad bank of dark storm clouds above small boats and the working waterfront.

chapters.title: Boats and port cranes
paragraphs: Small boats rest along the shore beneath the much taller cranes beyond.

photos.caption: Small boats moored beside a rocky shore with rows of port cranes beyond.

chapters.title: The harbour at sunset
paragraphs: The crane becomes a dark outline as the sky changes from gold to pink. Small boats sit almost still in the coloured water.

photos.alt: A crane and working barge silhouetted against a pale golden evening sky.
photos.caption: A crane and working barge silhouetted against a pale golden evening sky.

paragraphs: Festival decorations hang above Chinatown’s traffic. A bronze reader occupies a bench beneath the glass canopy of a city square.
